note: Rests on item 2: three PIF DDTL draws leave about $400m of committed capacity against a 12-month liquidity assertion that must stretch to Nov 2027 while the money funds losses, not a ramp (lesson 4) - sized only moderately because a 63.7% short float (item 4) is a live squeeze mechanism, the burn improvement is mechanically likely, and a +30.8 skew already pays for the downside I am leaning to.

Item 2 is the one real gap in the pack: Q3 is pre-released so the print turns entirely on the first quantification of ceasing PH-ILD promotion (roughly half of new-patient flow) and the fate of the >$1B 2027 ambition, into a stock up 42% since the settlement and 8.4% the eve of the print with no company guide to anchor it; item 1's deeply negative GAAP headline against a $0.77 consensus and item 3's thin post-payment cash add, netted against a 22% short float.

Near a non-result: Q3 was guided eight days before quarter end with consensus sitting on the guide, so only the FY arithmetic (item 1, Q4 needing +15-23% cc on a line decelerating 4-5 points a quarter) is open, and the Deckers read-through (item 2) is a two-week-old proxy the market has already chosen to ignore; a doubled short against upside-paid skew (item 5) and the broad Circana series (item 9) offset most of it.

Item 0 is a quantified consensus gap on the line this name actually pays for: Q4 consensus of $266-268m is only +3-4% QoQ after two straight above-consensus guides and a Q3 that grew +10% at the midpoint, with Space Systems (81% of revenue, +94% YoY) carrying a $2.8-3.2B backlog - I take the positive against a +9.4 put skew because that skew prices the already-realised Neutron slip, not the guide, and discount it for the 10-Q's unquantified MDA liquidated-damages exposure (item 3) and Q3 ATM supply (item 5).

Items 1 and 5 together: management's own stated reason for refusing to raise FY27 ('you can cancel a preorder') is unchanged ten days before launch, and this name has sold 5 of 7 prints including both prior raises, into a 13% week with 25-delta calls 27 vol points over puts on an expiry that ends before the 19 Nov launch - speculative launch demand rather than print information, which is why I run against the skew, with the genuinely strong Sensor Tower pre-order run-rate (item 0) as the offset.
